name: Growing Boxes Partitioning
definition: A volume partitioning method that adaptively divides the volume into sub-volumes (boxes) by clustering voxels according to their properties in both the volume domain and the transfer function domain, aiming to enclose few invisible voxels in the visible box subset.
summary: Growing Boxes Partitioning is an adaptive volume partitioning method that accelerates rendering by clustering voxels into gradient, uniform, and other boxes based on gradient magnitude and density similarity.
